open_points.subject: EXECUTION_STATUS_CONCLUSIONS and NODE_CONCLUSION_EFFECTS
open_points.text: the conclusion each NodeExecution status gives (A13 rules 5 and 7), what each node conclusion means for the run and for its dependants (A13 rules 5 and 7)
open_points.question: What is the closed node-conclusion taxonomy, and what are the exact key and cell types and complete rows of these two tables?
options: Define a NodeConclusion enumeration and map execution statuses to it, then map each conclusion separately to its run effect and dependant effect
Key NODE_CONCLUSION_EFFECTS directly by NodeExecution status and define structured run/dependant cells
Leave these meanings as run_graph logic rather than data-provider tables
open_points.default_guess: Define a NodeConclusion enumeration and give NODE_CONCLUSION_EFFECTS separate run-effect and dependant-effect columns.

open_points.subject: EXECUTION_STATUS_CONCLUSIONS outcome_unknown row
open_points.text: the conclusion each NodeExecution status gives (A13 rules 5 and 7)
open_points.question: How can the total status-keyed table represent outcome_unknown, whose conclusion depends on the EffectAttempt resolution and, when resolved applied, on whether the binding has output ports?
options: Give outcome_unknown a deferred conclusion that run_graph resolves using effects and binding facts
Make the table key include attempt state and binding-output presence
Exclude outcome_unknown from this table despite the stated totality
open_points.default_guess: Use a deferred conclusion whose final meaning is resolved by run_graph from effects.operation_element_conclusion.

open_points.subject: HTTP_METHOD_BODIES
open_points.text: whether an HTTP method carries a body (A09 rule 2) — is a correspondence over that taxonomy (SPEC_STANDARD 15.2): a table here keyed by the enumeration, total over its members, whose cells name members
open_points.question: What members do HTTP_METHOD_BODIES cells name, given that the stated fact is boolean and models defines no body-policy enumeration?
options: Add a closed body-policy enumeration such as carries_body/no_body
Use existing HTTP-method subsets rather than a keyed table
open_points.default_guess: Use boolean cells, with GET and DELETE false and POST, PUT and PATCH true.
